policy_extraction.implementation_notes: The provided text is an official news article (China Meteorological News Press, updated 2025-04-29) summarizing the joint departmental regulation 'Measures for Artificial Intelligence (AI) Meteorological Application Services' promulgated by CMA and CAC on 2025-04-23 and effective 2025-06-01. Because this source is a press release overview rather than the enacted statutory text itself, binding_strength and document_type are coded as regulatory_guidance rather than binding_law. The summary states that the Measures adopt classified and graded supervision and establish systems for algorithm registration and security assessments, labeling of AI-generated synthetic content, algorithm safety review, cybersecurity, data security, information dissemination review, and complaint reporting, alongside collaborative governance with enterprises, universities, and research institutions.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document predominantly frames China's AI meteorological governance around innovation enablement, emphasizing an inclusive and prudent approach, classified and graded supervision, data openness, R&D support, and the 'AI +' initiative to accelerate meteorological science, technology, and public services. Consumer and public safety serves as a secondary frame through the stated goal of balancing development and security and tackling potential hazards in AI meteorological services such as early warning and weather forecasting in a science-based manner. Minor traces of social stability (healthy, well-organized development and information dissemination review) and international standard-setting appear, but innovation enablement clearly dominates the stated purpose.

evidence_spans.quote: The document proposes that AI meteorological application services development shall balance development and security, adhere to the combination of innovation promotion and governance according to law. At the same time, an inclusive and prudent approach shall be taken and classified and grading supervision shall be conducted as to such services.
evidence_spans.source_section: Measures for AI Meteorological Application Services of China promulgated

evidence_spans.quote: This concerted endeavor will mobilize resources from all sectors of society to promote AI application and development in meteorology, injecting new vitality into speeding up the development of meteorological science and technology and public services,and promote the high-quality development of meteorology.
evidence_spans.source_section: Measures for AI Meteorological Application Services of China promulgated
